metric_protocol.aggregation: pooled out-of-fold road decisions; riders with more choices contribute more
metric_protocol.zero_division: undefined class precision/F1 is zero; two-class metrics are null if a class is absent
metric_protocol.tuning: do not choose hyperparameters or threshold using these held-out predictions

temporal_evidence.interpretation: Coverage is a diagnostic, not proof of temporal benefit. Value changes are counted only when the same edge/field is observed at least twice; age and missingness changes alone do not qualify.

lstm_comparison.interpretation: Positive accuracy/F1/AP/AUC differences favor full history; negative Brier/log-loss differences favor full history. GATv2 comparison changes both architecture and history; latest-only repeats the final frame with identical LSTM parameter count and sequence length. Use repeated seeds and adequate held-out riders before claiming benefit. No observed variation means this run cannot establish temporal value.

traffic_input_protocol: GPS profiles are rebuilt per fold using only pre-decision records and excluding the held-out rider
interpretation: Held-out-rider experiment; assess sample size and class balance before claiming generalization. Inspect provenance traffic_history for actual pre-decision coverage. Unknown traffic, even across multiple history steps, cannot establish a temporal LSTM benefit. These same folds must not also be used for hyperparameter selection.

provenance.traffic: fold-specific historical rider-GPS speed profiles; held-out rider and future records excluded
provenance.evaluation: every reported prediction is from a fold that excludes that rider
